---

## Task

Test the code on a single tile before running the parallel processing for all tiles. Ensure that the analysis is correct and record the execution time.

### Read the tile informatino (i.e. id and extent)

```{r}
# read the information of valid tiles
tiles_info <- readRDS(valid_tiles_info_path)
tile_id <- tiles_info$tile_id[35]
tile_extent <- terra::ext(
  tiles_info$xmin[35], 
  tiles_info$xmax[35], 
  tiles_info$ymin[35], 
  tiles_info$ymax[35])
```

### Calculate the Pearson correlation between H and TWI

```{r, eval=FALSE}
tictoc::tic()
# -------Data Pre------------
# Load rasters
twi_r <- rast(twi_450m_mosaic_clean_path)
vegh_r <- rast(vegh_450m_mosaic_path)

# Crop to tile
twi_rc <- crop(twi_r, tile_extent)
vegh_rc <- crop(vegh_r, tile_extent)

# Stack and name layers
stacked <- c(twi_rc, vegh_rc)
names(stacked) <- c("twi", "vegh")

# Clean up temporary rasters
rm(twi_r, vegh_r, twi_rc, vegh_rc)
gc()

# Create windows and calculate correlation
df_cor  <- create_spatial_windows(stacked) |>
        calculate_correlation_bywin()

colnames(df_cor)
# ------5km output-------
cor_r <- terra::rast(df_cor[, c("lon_mid", "lat_mid", "correlation")], type = "xyz", crs = "EPSG:4326")
cor_nc_path <- file.path(cor_twi_vegh_tiles_dir,
                     paste0("r_H_TWI_5km_", tile_id, "_map.nc"))
terra::writeCDF(cor_r, cor_nc_path, varnames = "r_H_TWI", overwrite = TRUE)
if(file.exists(cor_nc_path)) message(paste0("Saved:", cor_nc_path))

pval_r <- terra::rast(df_cor[, c("lon_mid", "lat_mid", "cor_pval")], type = "xyz", crs = "EPSG:4326")
pval_nc_path <- file.path(cor_twi_vegh_tiles_dir,
                     paste0("r_H_TWI_5km_", tile_id, "_pval.nc"))
terra::writeCDF(pval_r, pval_nc_path, varnames = "r_H_TWI_pval", overwrite = TRUE)
if(file.exists(pval_nc_path)) message(paste0("Saved:", pval_nc_path))

# peak_r <- terra::rast(df_cor[, c("lon_mid", "lat_mid", "peak")], type = "xyz", crs = "EPSG:4326")
# peak_nc_path <- file.path(cor_twi_vegh_tiles_dir,
#                      paste0("r_H_TWI_5km_", tile_id, "_peak.nc"))
# terra::writeCDF(pval_r, peak_nc_path, varnames = "r_H_TWI_peak", overwrite = TRUE)

rm(df_cor, cor_r, pval_r)
gc()

tictoc::toc()
```

### Visuallize the outcome to check it
I attempted to align the legend bar with the height of the plotting panel, but was unsuccessful.

```{r}
# source(here::here("R/extract_legend_dummy.R"))
cor_nc_path <- file.path(cor_twi_vegh_tiles_dir,
                     paste0("r_H_TWI_5km_", tile_id, "_map.nc"))
pval_nc_path <- file.path(cor_twi_vegh_tiles_dir,
                     paste0("r_H_TWI_5km_", tile_id, "_pval.nc"))

# extract legend for each plot
tictoc::tic()
legend_twi <- extract_legend_twi(twi_450m_mosaic_clean_path, tile_extent)
legend_vegh <- extract_legend_vegh(vegh_450m_mosaic_path, tile_extent)
legend_cor <- extract_legend_cor(cor_nc_path)
tictoc::toc()
```

```{r}
# Render raster plots once and cache as grobs
tictoc::tic()
# Generate raster plots without legend
p_twi <- plot_twi(twi_450m_mosaic_clean_path, tile_extent) + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_vegh <- plot_vegh(vegh_450m_mosaic_path, tile_extent) + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_cor <- plot_cor_twi_vegh(cor_nc_path) + theme(legend.position = "none")
tictoc::toc()
```

```{r}
tictoc::tic()
# Wrap raster plots and legends using ggdraw() + draw_grob()
p_twi_final <- ggdraw(p_twi) + draw_grob(legend_twi, x = 0.95, y = 0.5, width = 0.05, height = 1)
p_vegh_final <- ggdraw(p_vegh) + draw_grob(legend_vegh, x = 0.95, y = 0.5, width = 0.05, height = 1)
p_cor_final <- ggdraw(p_cor) + draw_grob(legend_cor, x = 0.95, y = 0.5, width = 0.05, height = 1)
tictoc::toc() 
```

```{r}

# combine multipal plots
tictoc::tic()
combined <- p_twi_final + p_vegh_final + p_cor_final + plot_layout(ncol = 3)

# save combined plot
ggsave(
  filename = here::here("data/figures/02_single_tile_com_plot.png"),  
  plot = combined,                 
  width = 15,                      
  height = 5,                      
  dpi = 300                       
)
tictoc::toc()
```
